digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow (_optionality.yml) and test suite parity
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml installs and tests the same targets as _build-and-test.yml but provides no unique coverage beyond the matrix test suite
Deleting the import-linter job removes one of eight concurrent job slots from a workflow that exceeds GitHub Free org-wide caps (21 slots needed vs 20 available)
Without a durable guard, future edits adding markers or moving test files risk silently removing optionality coverage with a passing build
A collection-based test must assert that test_core_optionality.py and test_optional.py still collect exactly 9 items under default suite selection
The import-linter check context in main-protection.snapshot.json becomes stale after job deletion and must be removed to prevent emergency rollback failures
